title: EU Data Act, Article 35: interoperability requirements for data processing services

answers.name: Interoperability specifications and standards for data processing services (Data Act Art. 35)
answers.description: Open interoperability specifications and harmonised standards for data processing services, which providers must comply with to facilitate switching and in-parallel use.

notes.dr_type: Interoperability requirements operate as technical standards (Article VI).
notes.dr_reference_paper: The EU participates in the Reference Paper on Services Domestic Regulation (in force since February 2024); sector coverage to be verified.
notes._scenario: Illustrative inputs for research discussion, based on Regulation (EU) 2023/2854 as adopted. Status of amendments (November 2026): the Data Omnibus is still in negotiation; the Council agreed its mandate on 21 October 2026 (ST 14756/26) and the Parliament has not adopted its position. Check the current text. Schedule entries are assumed and must be verified against the EU's consolidated GATS schedule.
